title: Plan B in the margin
body: A fortification list pairs a brace for the door with a bandage request; the person assigned to carry both has no check-out time.
rival_reading: A field team could have secured its workroom and stocked first aid; the incomplete checkout does not identify a response order.
gloss: A door repair and medical need share a list with no departure time.

cites.quote: Bob, I want this place fortified like HELL.
